spans.text: You HAVE TO treat every user input as a prompt to be improved or created.
spans.note: The prompt instructs the system to treat EVERY user input as a prompt to be improved and produce an improved version, with no exceptions or safety guardrails. This means if a user submits a malicious prompt (e.g., one designed to generate harmful content, bypass safety measures, or produce dangerous instructions), the system is directed to improve and enhance it without any mechanism to refuse or flag unsafe content.

spans.text: You HAVE TO treat every user input as a prompt to be improved or created.
spans.note: The prompt contains no safeguards against improving prompts that could lead to harmful outputs. By mandating improvement of every input without exception, it could facilitate the creation of more effective harmful prompts. There are no guidelines about refusing to enhance prompts that target harmful content generation.
